operations.name: manga.get
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListMangaApi.get gets one manga by its MyAnimeList ID through `MalMangaOperation.get`. It is the public facade for the `GET /manga/{id}` endpoint; use MalRequestOptions.fields to select the response shape and MalRequestOptions transport settings to override per call.
operations.auth: Not required for public manga data; pass an access token for list-related fields.

request.name: params
request.description: The manga lookup inputs; a MalMangaGetParams carrying the MyAnimeList manga ID.

nestedFields.name: id
nestedFields.description: The MyAnimeList manga ID.

request.name: options
request.description: Optional field selection and transport settings; a MalRequestOptions merged over the instance defaults.

nestedFields.name: fields
nestedFields.description: A comma-separated field selector, or the same selector as an array.

nestedFields.name: timeout
nestedFields.description: Milliseconds before a request is aborted. `0` disables the Axios timeout. Defaults to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; timeout errors carry the effective duration as `AniLinkNetworkError.timeoutMs`.

nestedFields.name: signal
nestedFields.description: Signal used to cancel in-flight requests.

response.name: id
response.description: The MyAnimeList numeric identifier.

response.name: title
response.description: The canonical MyAnimeList title.

response.name: main_picture
response.description: Optional image variants requested through the `fields` query parameter.

nestedFields.name: large
nestedFields.description: The large image URL, when MyAnimeList provides one.

nestedFields.name: medium
nestedFields.description: The medium image URL, when MyAnimeList provides one.

response.name: synopsis
response.description: The synopsis, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: status
response.description: The publication status, when requested (one of MAL's status values such as `finished`).

response.name: mean
response.description: The average score out of 10, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: num_chapters
response.description: The total number of chapters, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: num_volumes
response.description: The total number of volumes, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: media_type
response.description: The media type, when requested (for example `manga`, `novel`, or `one_shot`).

response.name: start_date
response.description: The first publication date in ISO 8601 format, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

response.name: end_date
response.description: The end publication date in ISO 8601 format, when requested via the `fields` query parameter.

errors.condition: for timeout, cancellation, or other transport failures

operations.example:
const api = new AniLink({ mal: { accessToken: "mal-token" } }).mal;
const manga = await api.manga.get({ id: 1 }, { fields: ["id", "title", "main_picture"] });

operations.name: manga.search
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListMangaApi.search searches MyAnimeList manga by keyword through `MalMangaOperation.search`. It is the public facade for `GET /manga`; use MalRequestOptions.fields to select the response shape and MalRequestOptions transport settings to override per call.

request.name: params
request.description: The search inputs; a MalMangaSearchParams carrying the keyword plus the optional paging filters.

nestedFields.name: q
nestedFields.description: The search keyword.

nestedFields.name: limit
nestedFields.description: The number of entries per page; defaults to 100, capped at 100 by MyAnimeList.

nestedFields.name: offset
nestedFields.description: The offset of the first entry; defaults to 0.

request.name: options
request.description: Optional field selection and transport settings; a MalRequestOptions merged over the instance defaults.

nestedFields.name: fields
nestedFields.description: A comma-separated field selector, or the same selector as an array.

nestedFields.name: timeout
nestedFields.description: Milliseconds before a request is aborted. `0` disables the Axios timeout. Defaults to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; timeout errors carry the effective duration as `AniLinkNetworkError.timeoutMs`.

nestedFields.name: signal
nestedFields.description: Signal used to cancel in-flight requests.

response.name: data
response.description: The search-result entries on this page.

response.name: paging
response.description: The paging node with the next-page URL, when the list continues.

nestedFields.name: next
nestedFields.description: The URL of the next page, when the list continues.

nestedFields.name: previous

operations.name: manga.updateMyListStatus
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListMangaApi.updateMyListStatus updates the authenticated user's manga list status through `MalMangaOperation.updateMyListStatus`. It is the public facade for `PATCH /manga/{id}/my_list_status` and requires a MAL access token from `MalCredentials.accessToken` via `buildMyAnimeListApi`; send only the `MalMangaListStatusUpdate` fields you want to change, form-encoded as MAL requires.
operations.auth: Required — MAL OAuth2 access token (`mal.accessToken` credential slot).

request.name: params
request.description: The list-status write inputs; a MalMangaListStatusUpdateParams carrying the manga ID plus only the fields to change.

nestedFields.name: id
nestedFields.description: The MyAnimeList manga ID.

nestedFields.name: status
nestedFields.description: The reading status to set; one of MalMangaListStatusValue.

nestedFields.name: num_chapters_read
nestedFields.description: The number of chapters the user has read.

nestedFields.name: num_volumes_read
nestedFields.description: The number of volumes the user has read.

nestedFields.name: score
nestedFields.description: The user's score out of 10.

nestedFields.name: start_date
nestedFields.description: The date the user started reading, in ISO 8601 form; MAL also accepts partial dates (`YYYY-MM` or `YYYY`).

nestedFields.name: finish_date
nestedFields.description: The date the user finished reading, in ISO 8601 form; MAL also accepts partial dates (`YYYY-MM` or `YYYY`).

nestedFields.name: comments
nestedFields.description: Free-form notes the user attached to the entry.

nestedFields.name: is_rereading
nestedFields.description: Whether the user is currently rereading the manga.

nestedFields.name: num_times_reread
nestedFields.description: The number of times the user has reread the manga.

nestedFields.name: reread_value
nestedFields.description: The reread value rating (0-5).

nestedFields.name: priority
nestedFields.description: The priority rating (0-2).

nestedFields.name: tags
nestedFields.description: User-defined tags attached to the entry; sent as a comma-separated string.

operations.name: manga.deleteFromList
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListMangaApi.deleteFromList removes a manga from the authenticated user's list through `MalMangaOperation.deleteFromList`. It is the public facade for `DELETE /manga/{id}/my_list_status` and requires a MAL access token from `MalCredentials.accessToken` via `buildMyAnimeListApi`.
operations.auth: Required — MAL OAuth2 access token (`mal.accessToken` credential slot).

request.name: params
request.description: The delete inputs; a MalMangaDeleteParams carrying the MyAnimeList manga ID.

nestedFields.name: id
nestedFields.description: The MyAnimeList manga ID.

request.name: options
request.description: Optional transport settings; a MalRequestOptions merged over the instance defaults.

nestedFields.name: timeout
nestedFields.description: Milliseconds before a request is aborted. `0` disables the Axios timeout. Defaults to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; timeout errors carry the effective duration as `AniLinkNetworkError.timeoutMs`.

nestedFields.name: signal
nestedFields.description: Signal used to cancel in-flight requests.

errors.condition: when no MAL access token is configured
for timeout, cancellation, or other transport failures

operations.example:
const api = new AniLink({ mal: { accessToken: "mal-token" } }).mal;
